items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of sections with heading triggers that open one at a time, or several with multiple; the panel fades in.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message in the page flow, in five tones with a status icon, a title, a description, actions and an optional close button; inline box or full-width banner.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A decision the user must make before going on, on Base UI's AlertDialog: Dialog's scrim and popup with role="alertdialog", no close button and no dismissal by an outside click, a Cancel and an Action in the footer.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's or a service's picture, with initials (or another fallback) while it loads or when there is none; circle or square in three sizes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short, non-interactive label for status or a count, in six tones and four appearances, including a coloured dot before plain text.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where the user is in a hierarchy, as a trail of links: a <nav> with an ordered list of links, the current place, separators and an ellipsis for collapsed items, on Base UI's useRender.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Fluent 2's Button: primary, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent appearances (plus Byterygon's danger) in small, medium and large, with hover, pressed, focus (the double ring), disabled and loading states.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick one day, several days or a range, on react-day-picker with date-fns, styled with token roles: control-sized day buttons, the accent solid for the chosen day and the accent subtle band for a range.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bounded surface that groups one subject, with a header (title, description, action), content and a footer; padding follows density.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Bar, line and area charts drawn as SVG from data in the colour-blind-safe chart.cat roles, with axes, legend, keyboard-readable tooltip, a hidden data table, decimation for long series, and an inline sparkline.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox on Base UI's Checkbox, ticked, unticked or mixed, in three sizes, with CheckboxGroup for several checkboxes sharing one value and a parent "select all".

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Inline code in running text (a SQLSTATE, an identifier, a digest) as a <code> in text.code-sm; long values break anywhere.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Read-only, highlighted code in editor.* and syntax.* colours, with line numbers, highlighted lines, a title bar and copy; virtualized above 1,000 lines.

items.name: code-input
items.title: CodeInput
items.description: A small code field on CodeMirror 6: one line (Enter submits) or several, PostgreSQL or JSON highlighting in the syntax.* colours, a read-only pretty viewer for JSON; themed through the token CSS variables and usable inside a Field.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section that shows and hides its panel: a quiet text trigger with a turning chevron and a panel that fades in.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: One choice from a long list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox: an input in an Input-like frame with clear and open buttons, and a popup of filtered items, groups, a no-results line and a status line, in three sizes.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: The searchable list of every action, on Base UI's Dialog and an inline Autocomplete: a search field over grouped commands with icons and shortcuts, filtered in the page by label and keywords, opened by a hotkey; no network.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: A menu opened by a right-click or the context-menu key on an area, on Base UI's ContextMenu: DropdownMenu's items (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus) at the pointer, on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) at z.popover.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A date or a range of dates, typed into a text field (read with date-fns in a format, yyyy-MM-dd by default) or picked from a Calendar in a popup, on InputGroup and Base UI's Popover, in three sizes.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: Term/value pairs in a <dl>: the term beside its value or above it, optionally divided by rules; long values wrap.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, on Base UI's Menu: items with shortcuts and a danger tone, checkbox and radio items, groups with labels, separators and submenus, on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) at z.popover.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: an icon, a title, a sentence and the way forward; centered for a panel, inline for small places.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.

items.name: file-input
items.title: FileInput
items.description: A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: A preview of what a link points to, on Base UI's PreviewCard: shown while the pointer rests on the link or the link has keyboard focus, styled as a Popover, size.panel.sm wide.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: A Fluent UI System Icon (vendored offline, MIT) as an inline svg: regular or filled artwork, sized by size.icon.*, coloured by currentColor or a token text role.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A square, icon-only action button (Fluent 2's icon-only Button) with Button's appearances in small, medium and large, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text input in Fluent's small, medium and large, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JsonViewer
items.description: A JSON value as a keyboard-navigable, virtualized tree in the editor's syntax colours; objects and arrays expand and collapse.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop window, on Base UI's Menubar: titles that open DropdownMenu-style menus (shortcuts, danger, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators, submenus), moving between menus with the arrow keys or the pointer once one is open.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: MultiSelect
items.description: Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: Site or app navigation with panels of links, on Base UI's NavigationMenu: a <nav> row of titles that open panels in one shared popup, links with descriptions and a current-page mark, and plain links in the row.

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: A number input on Base UI's NumberField with decrement and increment buttons, bounds, steps, locale formatting, and Fluent's small, medium and large.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moving between pages of a long list: a <nav> with Previous, page numbers (first, last, current and its neighbours, gaps as an ellipsis) and Next, from Button and IconButton, in two sizes.

items.name: password-input
items.title: PasswordInput
items.description: A password input with a show/hide button, on InputGroup and Base UI's Input, in Fluent's small, medium and large.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small non-modal panel attached to a control, on Base UI's Popover: a trigger, and a popup on elevation.flyout (color.bg.overlay) with an optional title, description, controls and a close action, placed on any side of the trigger.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar that shows how far a task has got, with an optional label and formatted value; value={null} is indeterminate.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: One choice out of several, on Base UI's RadioGroup and Radio: a fieldset of radios named by a FieldLegend, each option in a FieldItem with its own label and description, in three sizes.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: RelativeTime
items.description: A time relative to now ("in 14 min", "2 s ago") in a <time datetime>, kept current, with the absolute time in a Tooltip and as hidden text.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panes the user resizes by dragging or with the keyboard: a group of panels with focusable separator handles between them (ARIA window splitter).

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A scroll container with thin themed overlay scrollbars that fade in while hovering or scrolling; the viewport scrolls natively.

items.name: search-input
items.title: SearchInput
items.description: A search box on InputGroup and Base UI's Input: a search icon, type="search", and a Clear button (and Escape) while there is text, in Fluent's small, medium and large.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a list, on Base UI's Select: a trigger that looks like an Input and shows the chosen label, and a listbox popup with items, groups and separators, in three sizes.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, in a border role at border.width.1.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the window over a scrim, on Base UI's Dialog: right, left, top or bottom, three widths, a header, a scrolling body, a pinned footer and a close button.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The side panel of an app shell: a provider with the open state and a Ctrl/Cmd+B toggle, a size.panel.xs panel on either side that collapses to an icon rail (labels become tooltips) or hides, a header, a scrolling content area, a footer, labelled groups, menus of buttons or links, a toggle and the main area beside it.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: An aria-hidden placeholder in the shape of loading content (a text line, a block, a circle) that pulses slowly.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider on Base UI's Slider: one value or a range with two thumbs, horizontal or vertical, on a size.track track with an accent indicator, in three thumb sizes.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate activity indicator: a ring with a turning arc in size.icon.*, a polite status region that names what is loading.

items.name: split-button
items.title: SplitButton
items.description: Fluent 2's SplitButton: a main action joined to a menu of its variants, a Button and a chevron IconButton that opens a DropdownMenu (Base UI's Menu), in Button's primary, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent appearances and small, medium and large.

items.name: sql-editor
items.title: SqlEditor
items.description: A SQL editor on Monaco, loaded lazily from the app's own bundle (no CDN, no network), themed from the editor.* and syntax.* tokens of its region in every preset, mode and density, with run-at-cursor, error markers and a read-only mode.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One number that matters, with its label, an optional change (arrow, words for screen readers, colour by intent) and a description.

items.name: status-bar
items.title: StatusBar
items.description: The thin bar at the bottom of an app or pane: one-line status items that truncate, buttons, a spacer, and live items announced politely.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: The steps of a task done in order: an ordered list of numbered steps joined by lines, showing done (accent, check), current, upcoming and failed steps, horizontal or vertical, with completed steps optionally clickable to go back.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the accent solid and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A plain, semantic data table styled with the grid.* roles DBee's DataGrid uses: sticky header, density-aware rows, sortable headers, NULL marker, and a virtualized body for large row counts.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs on Base UI's Tabs: a strip of tabs (underline or enclosed, two sizes, horizontal or vertical) with panels; tabs can carry a status icon, be closed with a button or Delete, and be reordered by drag or Alt+Shift+Arrow.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A label the user applied and can remove: a chip with an optional categorical colour swatch and a remove button; TagGroup wraps them in a row.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input on Base UI's Input rendering a <textarea>, in Input's appearances and sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Field.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: A time of day typed into hour, minute, optional second and AM/PM segments, on Base UI's Input: the arrow keys step a segment and digits fill it, in three sizes.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notifications on Base UI's Toast: a region in a corner of the window (or in the page flow) of toasts with a title, a description, a tone (info, success, warning, danger), an optional action and a close button; sticky toasts and high-priority announcements; no network.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: ToggleButton
items.description: Fluent 2's ToggleButton on Base UI's Toggle: a Button that stays checked, in Button's primary, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent appearances and small, medium and large.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: Toggle buttons with one shared value, on Base UI's ToggleGroup: a segmented outline track (a layer with a hairline and a darker bottom edge) or separate subtle items, single or multiple selection, horizontal or vertical, small, medium or large.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of quiet controls with one tab stop and arrow-key movement (role="toolbar"), with groups, separators, links and a compact field.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for a control, shown on hover and keyboard focus, on Base UI's Tooltip: Fluent 2's bubble at z.tooltip on any side of the trigger, normal (the light flyout surface) or inverted (the neutral solid), with an optional keyboard shortcut.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A virtualized, keyboard-navigable tree following the ARIA treeview pattern: nodes with icons and trailing meta, lazy children with per-node loading and error-with-Retry rows, single selection, an action on Enter or double-click, type-ahead and a filter; only the visible rows are rendered.

items.name: type-badge
items.title: TypeBadge
items.description: A column's data type as a glyph and a short name in its data.type.* colour, for grid headers, column nodes and the value viewer.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Class-name merging that knows the Tailwind names of the Byterygon token roles. Every Byterygon component imports it from @/lib/cn.

items.name: control
items.title: control
items.description: What every Byterygon control shares (Fluent 2): the double focus ring (focusRing, focusRingWithin), Fluent's size names small/medium/large and the sm/md/lg and variant aliases kept for one release (controlSize, controlAppearance). Button, IconButton, ToggleButton, ToggleGroup and SplitButton import it from @/lib/control.

items.name: theme-scope
items.title: theme-scope
items.description: Gives a popup in a portal the data-theme and data-density of the control that opened it, and reads length tokens in px. Select, Combobox and MultiSelect import it from @/lib/theme-scope.

items.name: monaco
items.title: monaco
items.description: Loads Monaco lazily from the app's own bundle (ESM, its editor worker through Vite's ?worker, no CDN or AMD loader) and builds a Monaco theme from the design tokens in scope at the editor. SqlEditor imports it from @/lib/monaco; with a bundler other than Vite, set MonacoEnvironment.getWorker and replace the ?worker import.

items.name: monaco-theme
items.title: monaco-theme
items.description: The Monaco colour ids and SQL token types with the token role each one reads, and the function that turns resolved colours into a Monaco theme. The same source as the monaco-theme.ts output of @byterygon/design-tokens and the Theme Studio's Monaco export. @/lib/monaco imports it.

items.name: icons
items.title: icons
items.description: Fluent UI System Icons (MIT; the notice travels in the file): a curated set vendored offline, each icon an export with its regular and filled path data at 16, 20 and 24 px. Generated by scripts/icons.ts from packages/ui/icons. The Icon component imports it from @/lib/icons; import only the icons you use, so the rest are tree-shaken.

items.name: motion
items.title: motion
items.description: Looping animations without CSS keyframes (the token theme has none): the Web Animations API, periods derived from the motion tokens, never started under prefers-reduced-motion. Spinner, Progress and Skeleton import it from @/lib/motion.

items.name: theme-default
items.title: Byterygon theme: default
items.description: The Byterygon default, Aurora (Fluent 2 layered look): violet #6b4eff brand, cool grey neutral, violet and aqua glows behind translucent layers, radius 4 and 8, a black and white focus ring. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-classic
items.title: Byterygon theme: classic
items.description: Classic: the Byterygon default before Fluent 2 (TSK-57): a blue-teal brand on a neutral tinted with the same hue, light by default, comfortable density, WCAG 2.2 AA, and the fonts it had (Inter, then JetBrains Mono). Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-high-contrast
items.title: Byterygon theme: high-contrast
items.description: High contrast: WCAG 2.2 AAA (7:1 text, 4.5:1 for controls and focus), pure grey neutral, a deep blue accent and a thick focus ring. Comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-midnight
items.title: Byterygon theme: midnight
items.description: Midnight: dark first, on a deep blue neutral with a periwinkle accent. The light scheme is a cool blue-tinted counterpart. Comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-paper
items.title: Byterygon theme: paper
items.description: Paper: a warm light theme for reading. Cream backgrounds, a rust accent (so its orange, the warning colour, leans to amber), larger text with relaxed line height, rounder corners, comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-slate
items.title: Byterygon theme: slate
items.description: Slate: near-greyscale and minimal. A muted slate-blue accent on a barely tinted neutral, square-ish corners, light by default, comfortable density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.

items.name: theme-terminal
items.title: Byterygon theme: terminal
items.description: Terminal: dark first, a green accent on a green-black neutral, monospace for all interface text, 13 px text, square corners, compact density. Installs the --by-* token variables (Light/Dark via data-theme or .dark, Comfortable/Compact via data-density), the shadcn/ui variable aliases and the Tailwind names of the roles. Fonts are not included: copy @byterygon/design-tokens/fonts and import fonts.css for Inter and JetBrains Mono, or the system fallbacks are used.
